target_customer: Gamers wanting to play blockchain games without buying expensive NFTs (original); later users who earn in one country and live in another via a global operating account
problem: Blockchain games such as Axie Infinity required costly NFTs to start. LootRush let players access NFTs in a few clicks. The current YC page describes a global operating account.
business_model: Platform taking a share of NFT rental and play revenue (original, inferred from the product description); current model not stated
product_category: Web3 gaming access platform, later cross-border account

founders.name: Anderson Ferminiano
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page; no background given. The Block names him as CEO and refers to other founders without names.

investors: Angels including founders of Axie Infinity, Plaid, Wildlife Studios and Dapper Labs

competitors.name: Yield Guild Games
competitors.what: Guild that lent Axie Infinity NFTs to scholars for a revenue share (70 percent scholar, 20 percent manager, 10 percent guild)

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart contract based NFT rental, wallet handling and game integrations for a small team, with security risk.

defensibility.rationale: Guilds and game-native rental features competed on the same assets and a single dominant game limited the lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent absorbing the wedge; the company's public positioning later moved away from games.

market_need_then: Axie Infinity scholarships exploded in 2021 with YGG growing 8,500 percent year over year, showing demand for lowering NFT entry costs.

branding.domain_note: Uses lootrush.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Easy as a couple of clicks

brand_strength.rationale: Gaming flavored name with press only around the 2022 raise; many similar Loot-named products (LootLocker, Lootex) cause confusion and the name no longer fits the account positioning.

pivots.from: Platform for renting NFTs to play blockchain games (May 2022 coverage)
pivots.to: Global operating account to earn in one country and live in another (YC page)
pivots.why: Not stated in sources I found

outcome_analysis: LootRush rode the 2021 play-to-earn boom and raised a 12 million round led by Paradigm in May 2022, just before the sector cooled. The current YC description is a cross-border account, which suggests the gaming model changed, but no source states the cause or date of the shift. The company is listed active with open engineering roles.
notes: The company website fetch was blocked by a rate limited safety check and was not read. Round confirmed by The Block and CoinDesk; CB Insights labels it Series A while press says seed. YC page says founded 2022 while other sources say 2021. Outcome search found nothing on this company. Yield Guild Games traction figure is dated 2022 (after batch) and the Decrypt article is only dated 2021 from the search listing. No name origin or logo found.
